SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_id,
       l.product_id, l.quantity, l.unit_price
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_lines AS l ON l.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.operation_id = 'K14'
ORDER BY l.line_no;
